luz-maria-rivas.text: Voted NO on S. 2 (passed House 214-212), which adds $70 billion for ICE. Said: "Republicans' reckless budget gives ICE an additional $70 billion to terrorize our communities."

source.title: Rep. Rivas votes against Republicans' bill to fund ICE (June 9, 2026)

luz-maria-rivas.text: Introduced the HEART Act of 2026 to create a mental health office serving communities affected by ICE enforcement raids.

source.title: Rep. Luz Rivas press releases (June 18, 2026)

luz-maria-rivas.text: Urged USCIS to address DACA renewal backlogs and urged DHS to extend TPS for Salvadoran migrants.

source.title: Rep. Luz Rivas press releases (June 29 and July 7, 2026)

luz-maria-rivas.text: Introduced the Methane Pollution Accountability Act, requiring federal-lease oil and gas operators to pay royalties on vented/flared methane and plan to reduce pollutants in environmental justice communities.

source.title: Rivas introduces Methane Pollution Accountability Act (Aug 2026)

luz-maria-rivas.text: Voted against the Republican Stop Insider Trading Act (failed 198-232, July 23, 2026), saying it "will make mail-in voting harder" and carries restrictive SAVE America Act voter ID provisions. Co-sponsored the Restore Trust in Government Act banning stock ownership by members of Congress.

source.title: Rivas votes against Republicans' insider trading bill (July 23, 2026)

luz-maria-rivas.text: Welcomed the bipartisan 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act becoming law (House passed 358-32, June 23, 2026): "Trump held our bipartisan housing bill hostage because he would rather make it harder to vote than make life more affordable."

source.title: Rivas on bipartisan housing bill becoming law (July 11, 2026)

luz-maria-rivas.text: Voted for H.Con.Res. 86 War Powers Resolution directing withdrawal from hostilities with Iran (passed 215-208); her fourth such vote. Cited gas prices of about $8 per gallon in LA County.

source.title: Rivas votes to end war in Iran (June 4, 2026)

luz-maria-rivas.text: Voted to proceed with impeachment proceedings against President Trump (Sept 15, 2026): "The President needs to be held accountable for ICE's actions and this Administration's abuses of power."

source.title: Rep. Luz Rivas press releases (Sept 15, 2026)

luz-maria-rivas.text: Member of the Congressional Progressive Caucus; joined the House Sustainable Energy and Environment Coalition (May 2026) to advance environmental justice and clean energy.
